claims.claim: Isla Dawson is a geoform of the Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes marine ecosystem (ECOMAR-058).
SBAP/SIMBIO identifies a watershed unit named Islas Dawson, Wickam y adyacentes in the Magallanes region.
Institutional historical material places northern Isla Dawson within a former glacial-lake paleoenvironmental context that also involved Bahia Inutil and Segunda Angostura.
claims.scope_note: Historical/paleoenvironmental context only; do not infer current hydrology.
